options.label: Escalate if noncurative features
options.text: Proceed to surgical/multidisciplinary management when source criteria are not met.

locoregional.label: Medically fit and potentially resectable locoregional disease?

locoreg_fit.label: Medically fit, potentially resectable gastric cancer: multidisciplinary perioperative/preoperative treatment and gastrectomy pathway according to clinical stage and biomarkers.

options.text: Use source-preferred perioperative regimens and surgical sequencing for appropriate cT/N stage.

options.text: Consider perioperative immunotherapy strategy in MDT per source caveats.

options.text: Select by HER2, PD-L1, MSI/MMR, CLDN18.2 and line/prior exposure.

postsurg_pre.label: Did patient receive preoperative systemic therapy?

options.label: Surveillance

options.text: Only when source criteria are met.
